summary:
[Goal]
"replace "90 days" with "30 days" in every file under policy/"

[Constraints]
- Keep the rest of the text as it is.
- If a write is refused on a read-only file, stop trying on that file, leave it exactly as it is, and write policy/pending-changes.md naming the file that still needs a manual update.

[Done]
- Listed files under policy/ and read the relevant files.
- Wrote updated content to three files under policy/ with "90 days" replaced by "30 days".
- One file was read-only; the write was refused, so it was left unchanged.
- Created policy/pending-changes.md naming the read-only file that still needs a manual update.

[State]
- policy/ directory contains the updated files plus the new policy/pending-changes.md.
- One policy file remains unchanged (read-only) and is listed in policy/pending-changes.md.

[Key values]
- policy/
- policy/pending-changes.md
- "90 days"
- "30 days"

[Decisions]
- Stopped retrying the read-only file after the write was refused, per the user's instruction.
- Recorded the pending manual update in policy/pending-changes.md instead of modifying the protected file.

[User]
- User works with policy documents and expects strict, minimal edits that preserve surrounding text.
